results.text: The owner selected the available iOS Simulator for the current local-AI evaluation. The required ownership path is View → ViewModel → use case → app-owned protocol → adapter; the app must retain one Git repository while upstream library checkouts/pins remain separate. Step 1 maps files and dependencies, Step 2 inspects source, action traces, imports/injection, relevant tests, and ownership with pass/fail/blocked/N/A evidence, and Step 3 confirms the evidence matches the reviewed head.
